references.observed: Pale upstream-convex concrete arch with a central array of narrow ogee spillway chutes, regular piers and teal gate mechanisms. Smooth flanking wall panels tie into steep rock abutments. Yellow machinery sits at the southeast crest edge with a downstream power-yard deck.

Downstream view resolves ten crest gate bays, the tapered and stepped spillway toe, sloping outer wings, stepped near-bank platforms and power-yard equipment, and the DSİ mark on the northwest wing. Use a static dry operating state to show the actual chute profiles.
